name: Canonical Event Support
description: Declares canonical Phase 13 domain Events that this Site implementation can produce or consume.
purpose: Lets Codex and runtime validation verify event integration without redefining event semantics.

fields.description: Canonical Event IDs the trusted Site implementation can produce.
Canonical Event IDs the trusted Site implementation can consume.

relationships.description: Every declared canonical Event ID must resolve to the Phase 13 Event Registry.

validationRules.description: Every value in produces/consumes must resolve to an authoritative Event Registry event.
The Site Manifest may declare support but cannot change event payload or semantic meaning.
Browser-only code must not claim to authoritatively produce server/business domain facts.

delivery.notes: Manifest definitions contain technical declarations only. Secret values are prohibited.
